taxonomy.label: Italian Renaissance
taxonomy.teach: Balanced, idealised figures and linear perspective.

taxonomy.label: Northern Renaissance
taxonomy.teach: Minute detail and oil glazes north of the Alps.

taxonomy.label: Dutch Golden Age
taxonomy.teach: Everyday Dutch life, portraits and light.

taxonomy.label: Baroque
taxonomy.teach: Drama, movement and strong light and shade.

taxonomy.label: Rococo
taxonomy.teach: Light, playful elegance in pastel tones.

taxonomy.label: Romanticism
taxonomy.teach: Emotion and the sublime power of nature.

taxonomy.label: Impressionism
taxonomy.teach: Fleeting light in quick, visible brushstrokes.

taxonomy.label: Post-Impressionism
taxonomy.teach: Bold colour and structure beyond Impressionism.

taxonomy.label: Pointillism
taxonomy.teach: Pure colour applied in small dots.

taxonomy.label: Symbolism
taxonomy.teach: Dreams, myth and mood over description.

taxonomy.label: Expressionism
taxonomy.teach: Distorted form and colour to convey feeling.

taxonomy.label: Ukiyo-e
taxonomy.teach: Japanese woodblock pictures of the floating world.

taxonomy.label: Print
taxonomy.teach: An image made to be printed in multiple impressions.
